highlights: close to the local town centre
summary: Positioned in an exceptionally convenient and sought-after location, this beautifully presented two-bedroom first-floor apartment lies just a short stroll from the heart of the town centre. Offering immediate access to a vibrant selection of cafés, restaurants, bars, and retail amenities
description:
Well-regarded schools and colleges are also within easy walking distance, further enhancing its appeal to a wide range of buyers and tenants alike. The apartment represents an outstanding investment opportunity and is currently tenanted, achieving a rental income of £750 per calendar month, making it an attractive, ready-made addition to any property portfolio. Set within attractive and well-maintained communal gardens, the development provides a pleasant and welcoming environment, complemented by an allocated parking space for added practicality. A secure communal entry system offers both convenience and peace of mind, creating a safe and well-managed setting. Internally, the property is thoughtfully arranged and well-proportioned throughout. The entrance hall leads into a bright and spacious lounge, offering a comfortable and versatile living area ideal for both relaxation and entertaining. The fitted kitchen is well-appointed, providing ample storage and workspace to suit modern-day living. There are two generously sized bedrooms, each offering flexibility for use as sleeping accommodation, a home office, or guest space, alongside a well-presented family bathroom fitted with contemporary fixtures. Combining location, practicality, and strong investment credentials, this impressive apartment offers a fantastic opportunity for both investors and owner-occupiers alike. Early viewing is strongly recommended to fully appreciate the quality, convenience, and potential this superb property has to offer.

ENTRANCE HALLWAY The entrance hall provides a welcoming introduction to the apartment, laminate flooring and the added benefit of two built-in storage cupboards, offering excellent practicality for coats, shoes, and household items.

LOUNGE A well-presented lounge featuring laminate flooring, a radiator, a feature fireplace surround with inset and hearth, and a UPVC double-glazed window providing natural light.

KITCHEN A well-appointed kitchen comprising a range of fitted base and wall units with laminate worktops, inset sink unit with drainer and mixer tap, integrated oven, hob and extractor, and integrated automatic washing machine. Further benefits include inset ceiling spotlights, space for a breakfast table and chairs, and a UPVC double-glazed window providing natural light.

BEDROOM ONE Featuring a UPVC-framed double-glazed window and radiator.

BEDROOM TWO Featuring a UPVC-framed double-glazed window and radiator.

FAMILY BATHROOM A fitted white suite comprising a panelled bath with inset mains shower, wash hand basin and WC. Further benefits include part tiled walls to splashback and vanity areas, and a radiator.

EXTERNALLY The property benefits from well-maintained communal gardens offering a good degree of privacy, along with an allocated parking space.
